ForumPost.title: ForumPost
ForumPost.description: A student study inquiry posted in the collaborative Student Forum under AI Teacher supervision.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the student author.

authorName.description: Public display name of the student author (no email or private PII).

authorTrack.description: Academic stream of the student (Science, Arts, or General).

title.description: Concise title of the study inquiry.

body.description: Detailed description of the problem or question.

status.description: Current resolution state of the forum inquiry.

visibility.description: Visibility scope of forum inquiry for authenticated students.

repliesCount.description: Number of peer replies on this inquiry.

helpfulCount.description: Number of helpful endorsements on this inquiry.

teacherReviewStatus.description: AI Teacher smart supervision status on the inquiry.

teacherReviewNote.description: AI Teacher Socratic supervision note guiding students without giving away raw spoilers.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ForumReply.title: ForumReply
ForumReply.description: A peer answer or follow-up comment in a Student Forum thread, audited by the AI Teacher.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the replying student.

authorName.description: Public display name of the replying student.

body.description: Peer explanation or study help content.

postVisibility.description: Denormalized visibility matching parent post for query rule enforcement.

teacherBadge.description: AI Teacher supervision badge evaluating peer accuracy.

teacherFeedback.description: AI Teacher supervision feedback validating or guiding the peer explanation.

markedHelpfulByAuthor.description: Whether the original question author marked this peer reply as helpful.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the reply was created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/forum_posts/{postId}.description: Shared Student Forum inquiries moderated by AI Teacher supervision.

/forum_posts/{postId}/replies/{replyId}.description: Peer replies and AI Teacher supervision feedback on a Student Forum inquiry.
